title: Corn, frozen, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Corn is the grain of the annual grass Zea mays. Frozen cooked corn with no added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product that retains most nutrients and its natural sweet flavor after quick blanching and flash‑freezing.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Corn is one of the most widely consumed cereal crops worldwide.
Freezing immediately after cooking preserves the bright yellow color and crisp texture.
Corn contains carotenoids, especially lutein and zeaxanthin, which are beneficial for eye health.
In the United States frozen corn kernels are a common microwave side dish.
Corn with no added fat fits well into low‑fat dietary patterns.

items.title: Rich in carbohydrates
items.content: Corn provides a quick source of energy through complex carbs, useful for active individuals.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports normal digestive function and promotes satiety.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: It supplies thiamin, niacin and folate, which are important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Lutein and zeaxanthin help protect the eyes from age‑related changes.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes it suitable for low‑fat diet plans.

items.title: Corn allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to corn proteins.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Corn can raise blood sugar quickly, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Phytic acid may reduce the absorption of certain minerals when consumed in large amounts.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the corn in the microwave or on a skillet, add it to salads, soups, stews, or serve as a side dish with meat or fish. It pairs well with herbs, spices, and a drizzle of olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen corn in an airtight bag at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. After thawing, use within 2–3 days and do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
